title: Set up this instance
loadError: Could not check the instance. Check your connection and try again.

code.intro: This instance has no maintainer yet. Enter the setup code, then name the instance and create the first maintainer; after that, people can only join with a maintainer's invite.
code.label: Setup code
code.hint: The server writes the setup code to its log when it starts (look for setup_code); you can also run osfm setup-code on the server. Only the code from the latest start is valid.
code.form: A setup code has 16 letters and digits, like XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
code.invalid: Wrong setup code. Use the one the server printed at its latest start.
code.network: Could not check the setup code. Check your connection and try again.

account.intro: Create your maintainer account. As for every member, two-step verification is required.

name.label: Instance name
name.hint: Shown at the top of the page and as the issuer of this account in authenticator apps; at most 100 characters. It is saved together with the maintainer.
name.required: Enter the instance's name (at most 100 characters).

cities.intro: The cities your circle cares about, at least one. Each city's basemap is one file in the server's tiles directory, named after the city's slug.
cities.noArchives: There are no basemap files on the server yet. You can add cities below and complete the setup now, and place the basemaps later.
cities.name: Display name
cities.noTiles: No basemap yet. In the OSFM directory on the server, run the command below to extract this city's basemap (if the data directory is not ./data, add its tiles directory as a third argument). Until the file is in place, the map shows “no basemap yet” for this city.

add.title: Add a city
add.name: New city's display name
add.slugHint: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits or -; also the basemap's file name (slug.pmtiles).
add.bboxHint: minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat in WGS-84 degrees, for example 6.68,0.30,6.76,0.36. You can draw one on OpenStreetMap's export page.

errors.name: Enter a display name (at most 64 characters).
errors.slug: A slug has 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits or -.
errors.bbox: Write the bounding box as four numbers, minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat, each minimum below its maximum.
errors.none: Choose or add at least one city.
errors.invalid: The cities are not valid. Check their names, slugs and bounding boxes.
errors.network: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.

cities.nameHint: Saved with the maintainer; you can still change it here.

errors.codeInvalid: Wrong or expired setup code. Use the one the server printed at its latest start.
errors.done: This instance has been set up already.
